# otsec-collector test data

These are copies of the C1 fixtures `sel-751-simulated.json` and `profile-sel-751-ascii.json` (from `contracts/asset/testdata/valid/`) and of the C3 register `register-sel-751.json` (from `contracts/register/testdata/sel-751.json`, revision 2). The tests move the asset's endpoint to 127.0.0.1 (D2-10) and sign the register with a key they generate. Test secrets are test values (D2-5).
